subject: general
question:
What is the mode of the data given below? [Give your answer correct to 2 decimal places.]

 
 

 **Age in years**
 15 - 25
 25 - 35
 35 - 45
 45 - 55
 55 - 65
 65 - 75
 75 - 85
 
 

 **No. of patients**
 12
 18
 20
 25
 30
 20
 15
solution:
**Given:**

Age groups and number of patients:

15 - 25 : 12 patients

25 - 35 : 18 patients

35 - 45 : 20 patients

45 - 55 : 25 patients

55 - 65 : 30 patients

65 - 75 : 20 patients

75 - 85 : 15 patients

**Formula used:**

Mode = L + [(f₁ - f₀) / (2f₁ - f₀ - f₂)] × h

Where:

L = 

f₁ = Frequency of the modal class

f₀ = Frequency of the class preceding the modal class

f₂ = Frequency of the class succeeding the modal class

h = Class width

**Calculations:**

The modal class is 55 - 65 (highest frequency = 30)

⇒ L = 55, f₁ = 30, f₀ = 25, f₂ = 20, h = 10

⇒ Mode = 55 + [(30 - 25) / (2 × 30 - 25 - 20)] × 10

⇒ Mode = 55 + [5 / (60 - 45)] × 10

⇒ Mode = 55 + [5 / 15] × 10

⇒ Mode = 55 + 3.33

⇒ Mode ≈ 58.33

**∴ The mode of the data is approximately 58.33 years.**
